chapter.verse: Zan khuavak Topa ’ inn sunga a ding, no, Topa ’ nasem khempeuhte aw, hong pai un la Topa phat un!
Siangtho mun lamah na khutte uh laamto un la, Topa phat un!
Van leh lei a bawl Topa in Zion panin note thupha hong pia ta hen!
